_readme: Single source of truth for NASA files. 'verified: true' means the file links and credit line were read from the SVS/Worldview page on 14 Nov 2026. Re-check before submitting.

tracks.title: Night lights, 2012 to 2023
tracks.plainDescription: One frame from NASA's wide, flat map of Earth's night lights. In the change view, regions with more light are purple and regions with less light are orange.
tracks.colourMeaning: Regions with more light are depicted in purple; regions with less light are depicted in orange.
tracks.dataUsed: Suomi NPP VIIRS day-night band, Miguel Román, NASA GSFC; NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens.
tracks.dataCredit: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC.

tracks.title: Sea surface currents and temperature
tracks.plainDescription: Global ocean surface currents drawn as flowing lines, coloured by sea surface temperature, from March 2007 to March 2008. Blue is about 0 degrees C, green 10 to 20, yellow about 25 and red about 32.
tracks.colourMeaning: Current flows are colored by sea surface temperature: Blue is about 0°C, green 10°C to 20°C, yellow about 25°C, and red about 32°C.
tracks.dataUsed: Joint MIT/JPL project: Estimating the Circulation and Climate of the Ocean, Phase II (ECCO2).
tracks.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio

tracks.title: GEOS aerosols, 19 August 2025
tracks.plainDescription: A still image of airborne particles on 19 August 2025, 20:00 UTC. Sea salt is blue, dust is pink, smoke is orange and red, and sulfates are green. Hurricane Erin and Saharan dust crossing the Atlantic are visible.
tracks.colourMeaning: Particle types: sea salt is blue, dust is pink, smoke is orange/red, and sulfates are green.
tracks.dataUsed: Goddard Earth Observing System Forward Processing (GEOS-FP) 2Km Replay model.
tracks.credit: NASA's Global Modeling Assimilation Office (GMAO) and NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS)

tracks.title: Air quality model runs
tracks.plainDescription: Global concentrations of air pollutants including Particulate Matter (PM2.5), Ozone (O3), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) tracked from NASA's GEOS-CF system.
tracks.colourMeaning: Concentrations of air pollutants: Particulate Matter (PM2.5), Ozone (O3), Carbon Monoxide (CO), and Nitrogen Oxides (NOx).
tracks.dataUsed: NASA's Goddard Earth Observing System Composition Forecasting (GEOS-CF) system.
tracks.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio and NASA's Global Modeling and Assimilation Office
tracks.dataCredit: NASA's Goddard Earth Observing System Composition Forecasting (GEOS-CF) system.

tracks.title: Perpetual Ocean 2: western boundary currents
tracks.plainDescription: Major ocean currents along western boundary basins, visualizing ocean flow and sea surface temperatures.
tracks.colourMeaning: Flows from the surface down to 600m depth are white. Flows below 600m depth use the blue-cyan-white color scale.
tracks.dataUsed: Estimating the Circulation and Climate of the Ocean, Phase II (ECCO2).
tracks.dataCredit: Model output: Estimating the Circulation and Climate of the Ocean, Phase II (ECCO2).

tracks.title: DYAMOND global carbon dioxide
tracks.plainDescription: Global atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) concentrations in parts per million across the globe during early 2020.
tracks.colourMeaning: Atmospheric CO2 concentrations in parts per million (ppm).
tracks.dataUsed: NASA GEOS atmospheric model under the international DYAMOND project.
tracks.dataCredit: GEOS model output from the DYAMOND project.

tracks.title: Lightning seen from the ISS, 2017 to 2023
tracks.plainDescription: Global lightning events detected from the International Space Station Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) between 2017 and 2023.
tracks.colourMeaning: Lightning flash density observed using a 10-day roving window.
tracks.dataUsed: Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) on the International Space Station quality-controlled science dataset.
tracks.dataCredit: Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) on the International Space Station.

tracks.title: Atmospheric river in 3D
tracks.plainDescription: Three-dimensional visualization of an atmospheric river—a massive, flowing corridor of concentrated water vapor over the Pacific Ocean.
tracks.colourMeaning: Concentrated atmospheric water vapor transport corridor across the Pacific basin.
tracks.dataUsed: NASA Goddard Earth Observing System (GEOS) and MERRA-2 reanalysis.
tracks.dataCredit: NASA Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2).

tracks.title: GEDI forest height
tracks.plainDescription: Global forest canopy height mapped by the GEDI lidar instrument on the ISS, with darker green for shorter canopy and bright green/white for taller trees.
tracks.colourMeaning: Brown and dark green represent shorter vegetation (0-10m); bright green and white represent taller canopy height (up to 50m+).
tracks.dataUsed: Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) lidar aboard the International Space Station.
tracks.dataCredit: Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) lidar aboard the International Space Station.

tracks.title: Worldview: Terra True Color, 1 June 2024
tracks.plainDescription: Global true-color satellite snapshot of layer MODIS_Terra_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor captured on 2024-06-01 by NASA's Terra satellite.
tracks.colourMeaning: Corrected Reflectance (True Color) combines MODIS visual red, green, and blue bands for natural appearance.
tracks.dataUsed: MODIS instrument on NASA's Terra satellite via NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS).
tracks.credit: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) and NASA Worldview, part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)

assets.note: 1024x512 JPEG, official NASA GIBS snapshot API

tracks.title: Worldview: Suomi NPP True Color, 22 September 2024
tracks.plainDescription: Global true-color snapshot of layer VIIRS_SNPP_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor on the 2024 autumnal equinox (2024-09-22) captured by Suomi NPP.
tracks.colourMeaning: Natural-color imagery combining VIIRS high-resolution imagery bands (M5, M4, M3).
tracks.dataUsed: VIIRS instrument aboard the Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership (Suomi NPP) satellite.
tracks.credit: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) and NASA Worldview, part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)

assets.note: 1024x512 JPEG, official NASA GIBS snapshot API

tracks.title: Worldview: Land Surface Temperature, 1 June 2024
tracks.plainDescription: Global daytime thermal emissions snapshot of layer MODIS_Terra_Land_Surface_Temp_Day on 2024-06-01 showing terrestrial heat distribution.
tracks.colourMeaning: Thermal radiation indicating surface skin temperature; hotter land areas in red/amber and cooler areas in yellow/cyan.
tracks.dataUsed: MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature (Day) product via NASA GIBS.
tracks.credit: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) and NASA Worldview, part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)
tracks.dataCredit: NASA Terra / MODIS Land Surface Temperature product.

assets.note: 1024x512 JPEG, official NASA GIBS snapshot API

tracks.title: Worldview: AIRS Precipitation, 1 June 2024
tracks.plainDescription: Global atmospheric precipitation snapshot of layer AIRS_Precipitation_Day on 2024-06-01 showing daily rainfall and storm systems.
tracks.colourMeaning: Daily precipitation estimate from infrared sounding channels indicating rainfall rate.
tracks.dataUsed: Atmospheric Infrared Sounder (AIRS) aboard NASA's Aqua satellite.
tracks.credit: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) and NASA Worldview, part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS)
tracks.dataCredit: Atmospheric Infrared Sounder (AIRS) aboard NASA's Aqua satellite.

assets.note: 1024x512 JPEG, official NASA GIBS snapshot API

references.title: Data sonification: Caldwell 73
references.note: NASA's own sonification of a star cluster, with its original soundtrack. Deep-space data, so it is a listening reference, not an Earth track.
references.colourMeaning: Hubble optical image where distance from center controls pitch and brightness controls volume.
references.dataUsed: NASA Hubble Space Telescope observation dataset sonified by SYSTEM Sounds.
references.credit: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center. Sonification by SYSTEM Sounds (M. Russo, A. Santaguida).
